svg.title: An agent drafts an email with flexbox, lint_email reports display:flex, gap and border-radius as unsupported in Outlook on Windows, and after a rewrite to tables the lint passes with no errors.

text.tspan: Build a promo email with a two-column hero. It has to work in Outlook and Gmail.
